Marissa (partnerships): Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding checklist. Need confirmation on seller accounts, billing/tax IDs, legal scans, product packaging + SKU mapping, and VM/images. ETA EOD for go/no-go? :pray:
Luke (platform): I can finish seller account creation for AWS + Azure today. Need IAM perms to add the service principal.
Anika (legal): Please attach the draft reseller agreement and SOC2 cert. Also we need W-9 for US entity and W-8BEN for non-US sellers. Send to legal@redwood.com.
Priya (product): Packaging notes: one SKU per offering by default; we can do a bundle SKU for Dedicated+Support. Need sizing matrix (vCPU/RAM/GPU) + startup/install script. Can someone share the current sizing doc?
Diego (eng): Images/VMs: current artifacts are at s3://redwood-images/2026-03-10. Marketplace manifest needs updated image checksums — last time the marketplace rejected the AMI due to checksum mismatch. I'll run validation.
Diego (eng): Code to validate manifest:
```
# validate marketplace manifest
python tools/marketplace/validate_manifest.py --manifest manifests/aws-marketplace.json
```
Marissa (partnerships): Billing flow question — do we go metered usage or flat monthly for GA? Impacts pricing page and T&Cs. :thinking_face:
Ellen (marketplace): AWS supports both metered and fixed plans. For GCP, metered requires usage export; Azure Marketplace supports SaaS meter for usage-based billing. I'll DM platform docs + examples.
Anika (legal): Also flagging IP indemnity and data residency clauses — Azure has a few marketplace-specific contract hooks we should verify. Please tag me in the contract PR.
Luke (platform): IAM perms needed: grant `marketplace-deploy` role to `marketplace-bot` and `redwood-marketplace-ci` service account. @Sam can you do that?
Sam (devops): Done — granted `marketplace-deploy` to marketplace-bot and redwood-marketplace-ci in AWS and Azure. Also created GCP service account and granted roles/iam.serviceAccountUser. :white_check_mark:
marketplace-bot: Deployment scheduled to staging: 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC — manifest build #984 queued.
Marissa (partnerships): Thanks — next steps: 1) @Diego run manifest validation and post results, 2) @Priya share sizing matrix, 3) @Anika confirm legal checklist, 4) @Ellen send billing docs. If all green, aim for initial listing next week. :thumbsup:
Luke (platform): Quick blocker — need marketplace tax IDs from finance for non-US entity. @Finance, can you drop the VAT/GST numbers?
Anika (legal): Reminder: we need a redline of the MSLA before submission. I'll try to get that out by EOD.
Priya (product): I'll upload sizing matrix to the partnership drive and link here.
Diego (eng): Validation started, posting results in ~15m.
Marissa (partnerships): Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am PT if anything pops up.
